targetTexts.1: The plans of the heart belong to man, but the reply of the tongue is from the LORD.
targetTexts.2: All a man’s ways are pure in his own eyes, but his motives are weighed out by the LORD.
targetTexts.3: Commit your works to the LORD and your plans will be achieved.
targetTexts.4: The LORD has made everything for His purpose—even the wicked for the day of disaster.
targetTexts.5: Everyone who is proud in heart is detestable to the LORD; be assured that he will not go unpunished.
targetTexts.6: By loving devotion and faithfulness iniquity is atoned for, and by the fear of the LORD one turns aside from evil.
targetTexts.7: When a man’s ways please the LORD, He makes even the man’s enemies live at peace with him.
targetTexts.8: Better a little with righteousness than great gain with injustice.
targetTexts.9: A man’s heart plans his course, but the LORD determines his steps.
targetTexts.10: A divine verdict is on the lips of a king; his mouth must not betray justice.
targetTexts.11: Honest scales and balances are from the LORD; all the weights in the bag are His concern.
targetTexts.12: Wicked behavior is detestable for kings, for a throne is established through righteousness.
targetTexts.13: Righteous lips are a king’s delight, and he who speaks honestly is beloved.
targetTexts.14: The wrath of a king is a messenger of death, but a wise man will pacify it.
targetTexts.15: When a king’s face brightens, there is life; his favor is like a rain cloud in spring.
targetTexts.16: How much better to acquire wisdom than gold! To gain understanding is more desirable than silver.
targetTexts.17: The highway of the upright leads away from evil; he who guards his way protects his life.
targetTexts.18: Pride goes before destruction, and a haughty spirit before a fall.
targetTexts.19: It is better to be lowly in spirit among the humble than to divide the spoil with the proud.
targetTexts.20: Whoever heeds instruction will find success, and blessed is he who trusts in the LORD.
targetTexts.21: The wise in heart are called discerning, and pleasant speech promotes instruction.
targetTexts.22: Understanding is a fountain of life to its possessor, but the discipline of fools is folly.
targetTexts.23: The heart of the wise man instructs his mouth and adds persuasiveness to his lips.
targetTexts.24: Pleasant words are a honeycomb, sweet to the soul and healing to the bones.
targetTexts.25: There is a way that seems right to a man, but its end is the way of death.
targetTexts.26: A worker’s appetite works for him because his hunger drives him onward.
targetTexts.27: A worthless man digs up evil, and his speech is like a scorching fire.
targetTexts.28: A perverse man spreads dissension, and a gossip divides close friends.
targetTexts.29: A violent man entices his neighbor and leads him down a path that is not good.
targetTexts.30: He who winks his eye devises perversity; he who purses his lips is bent on evil.
targetTexts.31: Gray hair is a crown of glory; it is attained along the path of righteousness.
targetTexts.32: He who is slow to anger is better than a warrior, and he who controls his temper is greater than one who captures a city.
targetTexts.33: The lot is cast into the lap, but its every decision is from the LORD.
